tools.name: ultiwrite_forensics_account_get
tools.title: Connected Ultiwrite Forensics account
tools.description: Use to confirm which Ultiwrite Forensics account is connected and how many analysis units remain. Returns the sign-in method (and email for email sign-in), available and reserved units, connection permissions and limits. Read-only; it does not sign in, switch accounts or purchase usage.

tools.name: ultiwrite_forensics_capabilities_get
tools.title: What Ultiwrite Forensics examines
tools.description: Use when the user asks what Ultiwrite Forensics can examine, which file types fit, how to submit or how long results stay available. Returns accepted formats and limits, whether new examinations are currently available, the checks the engine applies, the workflow and the zero-data retention windows. Read-only.

tools.name: ultiwrite_forensics_upload_link_create
tools.title: Create a secure browser upload link
tools.description: Use when the user wants to examine a document but your client cannot send the file's contents. Returns a signed ultiwrite.co upload link, valid for 60 minutes, that works only for the connected account. Give the user the exact uploadUrl, keep the returned handoffId, and after the user uploads call ultiwrite_forensics_analysis_status with that handoffId. Choose a decision profile/materiality to shape the saved interpretation and ranked follow-up without changing detector execution or accounting. externalChecks is off by default; set it only with explicit user opt-in. The signed link fixes these choices. Creating the link does not use an analysis unit; the browser upload uses one.

externalChecks.description: Only when the user opts in: compare selected document business fields with GLEIF and IRS TEOS. Sends selected business fields, never the original document, to public registries. Separate evidence, not authenticity verification.

documentProfile.description: Decision context for interpreting the same frozen document evidence. invoice-ap, contract-diligence, and pre-sharing change questions, consequences, and evidence requests; they do not run a wider business investigation.

materiality.description: Consequence context for prioritizing follow-up. This does not change detector execution or create a binding decision.

tools.name: ultiwrite_forensics_analysis_start
tools.title: Start a document examination
tools.description: Use when the user asks to examine an authorized document for alteration, editing history, metadata, invoice/AP reliance, contract/diligence, or pre-sharing assurance. Submits exactly one original and optionally one earlier PDF reference for a PDF original. The pair remains one examination and uses one analysis unit when a usable report is produced; failed examinations release it. Send file/files for the original and referenceFile/referenceFiles for the optional earlier PDF. Never pass a local path or invent a URL. Choose documentProfile and materiality to change the question, consequence wording, and ranked next evidence over the same frozen engine evidence; this does not run broader business investigation. Repeating the exact same inputs returns the existing examination. externalChecks is off by default and requires explicit opt-in. If you cannot send bytes, use ultiwrite_forensics_upload_link_create.

contentBase64.description: The original file's exact bytes, base64-encoded.

file.description: The original document's bytes. Pass null when files is used.

files.description: One file object supplied by your connected app (for example a ChatGPT attachment). Pass [] when file is used.

contentBase64.description: An earlier PDF's exact bytes, base64-encoded.

referenceFile.description: Optional earlier PDF for the admitted reference comparison. Pass null when omitted or referenceFiles is used.

referenceFiles.description: Optional one earlier PDF supplied by the connected app. Pass [] when omitted or referenceFile is used.

externalChecks.description: Only when the user opts in: compare selected document business fields with GLEIF and IRS TEOS. Sends selected business fields, never the original document, to public registries. Separate evidence, not authenticity verification.

documentProfile.description: Decision context for interpreting the same frozen document evidence. invoice-ap, contract-diligence, and pre-sharing change questions, consequences, and evidence requests; they do not run a wider business investigation.

materiality.description: Consequence context for prioritizing follow-up. This does not change detector execution or create a binding decision.

requestKey.description: Optional idempotency key (UUID). Reuse it only with the same original, optional reference, profile, materiality, and external-check choice. Omit or pass null for a deterministic key over those exact inputs.

tools.name: ultiwrite_forensics_analyses_list
tools.title: List examinations
tools.description: Use to find the connected account's examinations, including ones started on the website or API. Returns ids, states and creation times in creation-time/ID descending order. Pass nextCursor as cursor until hasMore is false to retrieve the complete history. Read-only.

cursor.description: Opaque nextCursor from the previous page. Omit or null for the first page.

tools.name: ultiwrite_forensics_analysis_status
tools.title: Examination status
tools.description: Use to check an examination's progress with its analysisId, or with the handoffId from an upload link after the user uploaded in the browser. Returns processing, completed, partial, failed, expired or deleted, whether usage was charged or released, and when the report expires. Polling is free and does not advance processing.

analysisId.description: Analysis id returned by analysis_start, analyses_list or analysis_status. Pass null when handoffId is used.

handoffId.description: handoffId returned by upload_link_create, after the user uploaded in the browser. Pass null when analysisId is used.

tools.name: ultiwrite_forensics_findings_get
tools.title: Read findings and metadata
tools.description: Use to read a completed or partial examination: forensic summary, source-bound findings with severity and evidence references, page/region observations, document metadata, completed versus unassessed checks, examiner status and limitations. Partial evidence details require a prior explicit one-unit unlock; status and check states remain free. Findings are evidence to assess, not an authenticity verdict. Read-only.

analysisId.description: Analysis id returned by analysis_start, analyses_list or analysis_status. Pass null when handoffId is used.

handoffId.description: handoffId returned by upload_link_create, after the user uploaded in the browser. Pass null when analysisId is used.

tools.name: ultiwrite_forensics_report_get
tools.title: Get the forensic report
tools.description: Use when the user wants a deliverable. format pdf is the Document Forensics Report PDF. format metadata_analytics is the separate Metadata Analytics Report PDF. format result is the structured export. format manifest is the artifact manifest. format bundle is a zip of those required outputs and does not replace the separate files. format metadata remains the published engine report JSON. Partial evidence exports require a prior explicit one-unit unlock with evidence_unlock. Repeated downloads are free. Reports are deleted 24 hours after creation.

analysisId.description: Analysis id returned by analysis_start, analyses_list or analysis_status. Pass null when handoffId is used.

handoffId.description: handoffId returned by upload_link_create, after the user uploaded in the browser. Pass null when analysisId is used.

format.description: pdf, metadata_analytics, result, manifest, bundle, or metadata for the published engine JSON.

tools.name: ultiwrite_forensics_evidence_unlock
tools.title: Unlock partial findings and evidence (one unit)
tools.description: Use only after the user explicitly authorizes spending one Ultiwrite Forensics analysis unit to unlock this partial examination's findings, evidence, metadata and available exports. The unsuccessful analysis keeps its refund. Status and check states are free. The first successful unlock consumes exactly one unit; repeats, concurrent calls and later reads consume none. It does not rerun analysis or turn partial evidence into a completed examination. Use the same requestKey for retries; reusing a key for another examination is rejected.

analysisId.description: The partial examination whose evidence the user authorized unlocking.

requestKey.description: A saved UUID for this explicit unlock; reuse it after an uncertain response.

tools.name: ultiwrite_forensics_analysis_delete
tools.title: Delete an examination
tools.description: Use only when the user asks to delete an examination now. Deletes the report and any remaining engine copies before the automatic 24-hour deletion. A pending examination is canceled and its reserved unit released; a completed examination stays charged. Cannot be undone.
